fieldActionRoleStateChecks: Both alternative source native file controls remain in exact order with manifest-containing directory label, archive input and existing 00-Inbox text destination. No invented radio/format/key/password inputs or picker window.

Standalone actual owner component mapped to library parent in metadata; no invented host shell. Busy close lock and file-selected dirty confirmation remain wrapper contracts, not extra initially displayed controls.

limitations: Static review does not prove guards, action execution, role enforcement, keyboard/focus, resizing or responsive behavior.
